title: New required PR-check workflows need CODEOWNERS + .policy.yml entries to actually gate merges
answers: What else do I need to add besides the workflow file for a new required PR check?
My new pr-*.yml workflow runs but doesn't block merge
How to make a GitHub Actions check required in this repo
body: Adding a new `.github/workflows/pr-*.yml` that should act as a merge gate requires three co-changes: (1) a CODEOWNERS entry for the workflow file, (2) a top-level entry in .policy.yml's policy list ("Workflow X succeeded or skipped"), and (3) a matching approval_rules block with `changed_files.paths` regexes and a `has_workflow_result` condition allowing `skipped`/`success`. Omitting any of these means the workflow runs but isn't enforced as a required check.
applies: Any new required .github/workflows/pr-*.yml check in grafana/grafana
